title: Data & AI Product Owner
description:
Data & AI Product Owner

London (Hybrid) | Up to £80,000 + Bonus + Benefits

A fantastic opportunity for a Data & AI Product Owner to join a growing product function focused on delivering innovative data and AI solutions. This role offers genuine ownership across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and prioritisation through to launch and adoption, while working closely with data scientists, engineers, and senior business stakeholders in a highly collaborative environment.

The Company

They are a large, international professional services organisation investing heavily in data, AI and digital transformation. The business is building a dedicated Data & AI capability to develop products that improve decision-making, automate complex workflows, and unlock greater value from data.

With strong executive sponsorship and significant investment, they offer the chance to work on business-critical products that have a visible impact across multiple functions and user groups. This is an opportunity to help shape a growing product organisation from an early stage.

The Role

As a Data & AI Product Owner, you will be responsible for driving the development and delivery of data and AI products from concept through to production.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Identifying opportunities where data and AI can solve business challenges
  • Leading discovery activities and defining product requirements
  • Gathering and managing stakeholder needs across multiple business areas
  • Owning and prioritising the product backlog
  • Defining product roadmaps and managing competing priorities
  • Working closely with Data Scientists, ML Engineers and technology teams throughout delivery
  • Supporting product launches, adoption and continuous improvement
  • Contributing to the wider Data & AI product strategy

You will work across a range of products including AI-powered workflow solutions, knowledge retrieval tools, analytics products, commercial intelligence platforms and generative AI applications.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager
  • Strong track record delivering products from ideation through to launch
  • Experience owning, refining and prioritising product backlogs
  • Excellent stakeholder management and requirements gathering skills
  • Ability to balance product strategy, discovery and delivery responsibilities
  • Experience working with engineering teams and technical stakeholders
  • Exposure to data products, analytics platforms or AI-enabled solutions
  • Understanding of modern data environments and product development practices
  • Experience within professional services, consulting, financial services, legal services or other regulated environments would be advantageous
  • Exposure to Databricks or similar modern data platforms is beneficial
  • Familiarity with AI or Generative AI use cases is desirable

What They Offer

  • Exposure to high-profile Data & AI initiatives
  • Opportunity to shape product strategy and roadmap decisions
  • Clear career development within a rapidly growing Data & AI function
  • Collaborative environment working alongside data, engineering and business leaders

How to Apply

If you are an experienced Product Owner or Product Manager with a passion for data products, AI innovation and stakeholder-led product development, apply today to learn more about this exciting opportunity.
